issue.title: test_commits_sidecar_filter_png_snapshot can capture before the Artifacts pane brief settles
issue.description: PROPOSED BY phase bead sase-um.5.1.2 note #1. During that phases bulk just update-visual-snapshots run, tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_commits.py::test_commits_sidecar_filter_png_snapshot captured the raced pre-brief frame. Every subsequent isolated and full visual run then failed because the async ArtifactsPaneBrief reliably finished before the real assertion. A scoped recapture restored the intended frame and passed four repeated runs. Current source waits for sidecar filter state, commit text, and generic visual idle, but unlike neighboring Stitches snapshots it never waits for the pane-brief text Commits landed through SASE. Add an explicit semantic wait before assert_page_png so bulk regeneration cannot bless the pre-brief frame again.

task_type_fields.evidence: Bulk regeneration captured the pre-brief frame once; the resulting golden then failed every isolated and full run because the async hint normally settled first. Scoped recapture passed four repeated runs. The race is in snapshot readiness, not product rendering, and current source has no semantic wait for the Stitches pane brief.

payload.description: The closed visual-backlog task documents why readiness races must be fixed semantically instead of rebaselined; sase-uy is the node-specific missing pane-brief wait discovered during that class of regeneration.
Sibling node in the same file with the same remedy shape: add an explicit semantic wait before assert_page_png because wait_for_visual_idle is not a sufficient readiness signal for this pane.
